Dhaka, June 1 -- Finance minister AHM Mustafa Kamal's target of containing the rate of inflation at 6 percent in the upcoming fiscal year is being described as ambitious by some economists.

The finance minister announced the target in the budget proposals for FY23-24 placed at the Parliament on Thursday.

The existing rate of inflation in the country has soared to over 9 percent.
